description:
Earn 15% commission promoting Spares High-Fidelity Earplugs, while giving your audience a 15% discount on a product that solves a real problem: protecting hearing in loud environments without muffling the sound.

Spares earplugs are designed for concerts, festivals, musicians, DJs, photographers, and anyone regularly exposed to high sound levels. Instead of muffling everything like foam plugs, Spares reduces harmful volume while keeping music clear and balanced.

What makes us different

Many earplugs block too much sound or feel uncomfortable during long use. Spares focuses on clarity, comfort, and everyday usability.

Our unique patented design combines a precision metal sound filter with a soft silicone fit, reducing damaging sound levels while preserving the natural listening experience. Users enjoy concerts, rehearsals, festivals, and nightlife while protecting their hearing.

As awareness of hearing protection continues to grow among musicians and event-goers, Spares provides an easy solution people are actively looking for.

How affiliates can earn

Affiliates earn 15% commission on every sale.

You’ll also receive a 15% discount code for your audience, making it easy to convert followers who are interested in concerts, music culture, nightlife, or hearing protection.

Each pair generates 15% in commission, and your code gives your audience a strong incentive to purchase. Single purchases range from $48 - $139.

You can promote using:

• a custom affiliate link
• a personalized coupon code
• both together for maximum conversions

How to promote us

Spares performs especially well with audiences connected to:

• live music and concerts
• DJs and nightlife culture
• musicians and bands
• festival communities
• concert photographers and videographers
• event staff and production crews
• motorcycle and travel communities
• lifestyle and gear creators

Affiliates commonly promote Spares through:

• social media posts and reels
• YouTube gear and concert content
• blog articles and product roundups
• LinkTree or creator storefronts
• newsletters and deal listings

Because hearing protection is relevant to so many loud environments, Spares fits naturally into a wide range of content.

Other information

Affiliates receive everything needed to start promoting immediately, including:

• a unique tracking link
• a customizable coupon code
• marketing assets available inside the affiliate platform

Learn more about Spares here:
https://grabyourspares.com

Questions can be directed to:
grabyourspares@gmail.com

Spares Affiliate Program Terms & Conditions

Effective Date: 2-1-26

These Affiliate Program Terms & Conditions (“Agreement”) govern participation in the Spares Affiliate Program (“Program”). By applying to or participating in the Program, you agree to the terms below.

1. Affiliate Relationship

Affiliates are independent marketing partners and are not employees, representatives, agents, or legal partners of Spares.

Affiliates may not:

• Represent themselves as employees or official representatives of Spares
• Make claims, warranties, or guarantees on behalf of Spares
• Bind Spares to any agreement or obligation

Affiliates are solely responsible for how they promote the Program within the guidelines outlined here.

2. Commission Structure

Affiliates earn:

• 15% commission on completed, qualifying orders generated through their unique affiliate link or assigned coupon code.

Commissions are calculated on the final order subtotal after discounts and before taxes and shipping.

Orders must be:

• Successfully paid
• Not fraudulent
• Not charged back

Spares does not accept returns on personal wear items; however, chargebacks or fraudulent transactions may result in commission reversals.

3. Payout Terms

Commissions are reconciled at the end of each calendar month.

Approved commissions are paid via PayPal during the first week of the following month.

Affiliates are responsible for:

• Providing accurate PayPal payment information
• Complying with any tax obligations applicable in their jurisdiction

Failure to provide valid payment details may delay payout.

4. Promotional Guidelines

Affiliates may promote Spares using their unique link and/or coupon code through approved channels including:

• Social media
• Email marketing
• Personal websites
• Deal platforms

Affiliates may not:

• Run paid Google Ads or paid search campaigns using the Spares brand name, trademark, or variations thereof
• Bid on branded keywords related to Spares
• Use domain names, social handles, or advertising that impersonates Spares
• Present themselves as official representatives of the brand
• Modify, alter, or distort Spares logos, branding, or marketing materials

Use of official logos must remain unaltered and in their original form.

5. Trademark & Brand Protection

“Spares” is a registered trademark.

Affiliates are granted a limited, revocable, non-exclusive license to use approved branding materials solely for the purpose of promoting Spares within this Program.

This license may be revoked at any time.

Unauthorized use of trademarks, misleading claims, or brand impersonation will result in immediate termination from the Program.

6. Prohibited Conduct

The following actions are strictly prohibited:

• Self-referrals or purchasing through your own affiliate link
• Creating fake orders or artificial traffic
• Spam email marketing
• Misleading, false, or deceptive claims
• Offering unauthorized discounts beyond the approved 15% coupon
• Posting coupon codes on unauthorized scraping sites (if you choose to include this)

Violation may result in:

• Commission forfeiture
• Immediate removal from the Program

7. Program Modifications

Spares reserves the right to:

• Modify commission rates
• Adjust promotional rules
• Terminate affiliate participation
• Update these Terms at any time

Affiliates will be notified of material changes.

8. Termination

Spares may terminate any affiliate at its sole discretion for violations of these Terms or conduct deemed harmful to the brand.

Upon termination:

• Pending commissions may be reviewed
• Fraudulent commissions will be voided

9. Limitation of Liability

Spares shall not be liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from participation in the Program.

Participation is at the affiliate’s own risk.

10. Acceptance

By applying to or participating in the Spares Affiliate Program, you acknowledge and agree to these Terms & Conditions.
